column11: convention, the book's registry route: the earliest Phase 3 primary completion of the line still modelled plus two calendar years. HARMONi-7 (NCT06767514) April 2028 and HARMONi-3 (NCT05899608) 2028-12-31, both estimated on the registry (last updated 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-08, read 2026-11-16), give 2030. The 2027 start rested on an approval of the HARMONi BLA (NCT06396065) at its 2026-11-14 PDUFA date; the FDA issued a complete response letter on 2026-11-15 instead (8-K 0001599298-26-000092), and Summit's release names no resubmission, no meeting with the FDA and no further OS analysis (exhibit 99.1)
column12: the case for earlier: Summit guides the squamous cohort's PFS events in Q4 2026 with an early interim OS analysis alongside, an OS interim independent of PFS in the first half of 2027, and the non-squamous cohort's PFS events in the first half of 2027 (Q3 2026 10-Q, 0001599298-26-000090). A filing on the 2027 interim OS with no lag reaches a decision by 2028-02 on the priority clock (6 months from a 60-day filing date, data/fda_review_clock.csv) or 2028-06 on the standard one (10 months), so 2029 is the earliest first full year if that interim OS is significant. The case for later: the FDA has now said it will not approve ivonescimab on PFS without significant OS, so a PFS readout alone does not start a filing

column11: JUDGEMENT: the first-line line (HARMONi-3 NCT05899608 and HARMONi-7 NCT06767514, Phase 3) is now the whole asset, so pos is that line's own probability, no longer a blend. It is set between two published rates. Upper, 0.439: oncology Phase 3 to approval, BIO/Informa/QLS Clinical Development Success Rates 2011-2020, Figure 2, 47.7% x 92.0% (data/pos_by_area.csv), which counts a Phase 3 as a success on any primary endpoint, PFS included. Lower, 0.257: Sherry AD et al., JAMA Oncol 2025;11(7):718-724, doi:10.1001/jamaoncol.2025.1002, PMID 40451185: of 791 superiority Phase 3 oncology trials published 2002 to 2024, 53% (420) met their primary endpoint but 28% (221) showed OS superiority, so 221/791 x 92.0% = 0.257. The midpoint, (0.257 + 0.439) / 2 = 0.348, is a judgement, not a measurement
column12: why the bar moved: the complete response letter of 2026-11-15 says PFS without significant OS 'does not support a positive benefit-risk profile' for ivonescimab (8-K 0001599298-26-000092), in a setting where Summit says no approved regimen had shown OS. First line is a harder setting for that test, since the comparator, pembrolizumab with chemotherapy, has proven OS, so a first-line approval on PFS alone is not a case this book should price; HARMONi-3's OS is a primary endpoint in each cohort and Summit sized both cohorts 'to sufficiently power for both primary endpoints (PFS and OS)' (Q3 2026 10-Q, 0001599298-26-000090; FY2025 10-K, 0001599298-26-000015). The case for higher: those trials are powered for OS, which many of Sherry's 791 were not; ivonescimab beat pembrolizumab on OS in HARMONi-2, HR 0.73, p=0.009 (8-K 0001599298-26-000078), and there are three shots (two HARMONi-3 cohorts and HARMONi-7). The case for lower: HARMONi-2 and HARMONi-A ran in China, and the global HARMONi, with 165 of 438 patients western (8-K 0001599298-26-000081), missed OS. Before the letter this row was 0.403661, a blend with the post-TKI line at 0.1212; stepping to the seed's own failure leg on 0.439 gives rNPV $1,655.8mm against $1,312.5mm at 0.348

column11: published: oncology NDA/BLA to approval, 92.0%, BIO/Informa/QLS Clinical Development Success Rates 2011-2020, Figure 2 (data/pos_by_area.csv, 'Filed'). The leg if HARMONi-3 (NCT05899608) reads positive on overall survival: the squamous cohort's primary PFS analysis with its early interim OS (Q4 2026), then the OS interim independent of PFS (first half of 2027; Q3 2026 10-Q, 0001599298-26-000090). The engine prices the legs once, on the first HARMONi-3 catalyst (2026-12-31)
column12: resolve as met only on a statistically significant OS result in a cohort: a PFS win with OS immature or not significant is the result the FDA refused on 2026-11-15 (8-K 0001599298-26-000092), so the catalyst stays open until OS reads. With pos at 0.348 the implied chance of that OS result is 0.348 / 0.92 = 0.378. Not in the leg: regulatory milestones owed to Akeso on approval (up to $1,050mm in all, Q2 2026 10-Q Note 4)
